Eating it will restore a bit of health.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Toasty Chillshrooms are a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] can make Toasty Chillshrooms by burning Chillshrooms with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They are noted to taste better after being toasted. Eating a Toasty Chillshroom will restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to Link. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Toasty Chillshrooms return in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] can make them by dropping [[Chillshroom]]s near a [[Fire]] or in a [[Scorching Climate]]. When compared to regular Chillshrooms, Toasty Chillshrooms are known to taste better. If Link eats a Toasty Chillshroom, it will restore three-quarters of one of his [[Heart]]s. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Chillshroom * Food * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
